unit_of_analysis_rule: Institutional coverage is the unit of analysis. Outlet presence is necessary context but not sufficient evidence of adequate journalism.
original_vs_aggregation_rule: Distinguish original reporting from aggregation/reposting. ANNN partner republishing is distribution, not local original production by the partner.

outlets.name: Marshall Mountain Wave
outlets.ownership_notes: LOC catalog lists CherryRoad Media, Inc.; chamber page lists cherryroad.com staff contacts.
outlets.notes: Nominal local paper present. Homepage sample (2026-08-10) dominated by community/lifestyle; school-board meeting listed under Events calendar — calendar listing ≠ meeting coverage proof.

outlets.name: Lafayette County Press
outlets.ownership_notes: Publisher/editor Tommy & Lucy Goodwin (Stamps) per outlet about page.
outlets.notes: Nominal county paper present. Institutional coverage frequencies not yet content-coded.

outlets.name: Lafayette County Democrat
outlets.ownership_notes: LOC catalog entry exists (sn89051457); current operating status and digital presence require field verification.
outlets.notes: Do not count as proven active digital coverage without operating-site confirmation.

outlets.name: Helena World (Helena-West Helena World)
outlets.ownership_notes: Local purchase Sept 2019 after GateHouse closure attempt (ADG feature).
outlets.notes: Strongest rural/Delta evidence in this pilot that nominal paper ≠ dead paper: city-council stories on site; ADG 2020 feature describes Quorum Court/City Council/school-board attendance. Still needs systematic matrix coding.

outlets.name: The Arkansas Leader
outlets.ownership_notes: Self-described family-owned; Jacksonville address 404 Graham Rd.
outlets.notes: Self-describes coverage of local city councils/schools. Self-description ≠ coded frequency/depth audit.

outlets.name: Northwest Arkansas Democrat-Gazette
outlets.ownership_notes: WEHCO / Northwest Arkansas Newspapers joint structure; Community Journalism Project philanthropic support layer.
outlets.notes: High-capacity regional daily covers Benton County government (e.g., industrial-development authority / Quorum Court reporting). Capacity ≠ every institution routinely covered.

outlets.name: Arkansas Democrat-Gazette
outlets.ownership_notes: Statewide capital paper; Community Journalism Project donor layer via Arkansas Community Foundation.
outlets.notes: Metro/state capacity present. Jacksonville stories may appear; municipal granular continuity still needs coding vs Arkansas Leader.

outlets.name: Arkansas Times
outlets.ownership_notes: Longstanding Little Rock alternative outlet (Encyclopedia of Arkansas).
outlets.notes: Metro alternative voice — institutional coverage patterns require separate coding.

outlets.name: Arkansas Nonprofit News Network (ANNN)
outlets.ownership_notes: Independent nonprofit; stories republished by partner newsrooms statewide.
outlets.notes: Important for distinguishing original production vs partner aggregation/reposting.

outlets.name: KUAR / Little Rock Public Radio
outlets.ownership_notes: UA Little Rock public service unit; collaboration grants with KUAF/KASU noted in 2025 WRF award coverage.
outlets.notes: Radio medium gap-fill relative to print-only desert measures.

ownership_concentration_signals: CherryRoad Media ownership of Marshall Mountain Wave (chain)
WEHCO regional/statewide dominance in Benton + Pulaski markets
medium_gaps_observed_in_pilot: Television local-news inventory not yet systematically coded per geography
University/student journalism not yet mapped per geography
Rural radio newscasts claimed regionally (ArkansasRadio.com) — Jacksonville listed in market list; beat-level coding open
do_not_infer: No Arkansas 'news desert' scores invented from this inventory
No claim that every listed outlet provides adequate institutional scrutiny
